say:1:1430240101:1.text: Of course, it was the Queen who established Sal'thorin as our sanctuary!
say:1:1430240101:1.source_cn: 当然，是女王建立了庇佑我们的萨洛克兰！
say:1:1430240101:1.male: Of course, it was the Queen who established Sal'thorin as our sanctuary!
say:1:1430240101:1.female: Of course, it was the Queen who established Sal'thorin as our sanctuary!

say:2:1430240102:1.text: As a citizen of Sal'thorin, I will forever be grateful to her.
say:2:1430240102:1.source_cn: 作为萨洛克兰的一员，我当然要对她心怀感恩！
say:2:1430240102:1.male: As a citizen of Sal'thorin, I will forever be grateful to her.
say:2:1430240102:1.female: As a citizen of Sal'thorin, I will forever be grateful to her.
